title: 第5章 密林设阱，反猎青云女修
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
妖兽在密林中缓步前行。

    后腿的麻木已消退大半，但那条腿仍有些发软，速度比平时慢了两成。

    这让妖兽很烦躁，鼻孔不断喷出粗重气息，双眼扫视密林寻找那个胆敢让它吃瘪的人类的踪迹。

    少女端坐妖兽背上神情淡然。

    她并不急——一个没有修为的凡人，凭几分不知从哪得来的机缘和一手使毒的本事，能在她手下逃多久？

    一炷香，最多一炷香。

    妖兽忽然停下脚步打了个响鼻。

    前方十丈处，几棵枯树横七竖八倒在路面上，树干上覆盖着厚厚苔藓。

    绊马索？

    少女嘴角勾起一丝讥讽。

    用枯树当绊马索对付寻常马匹或许有用，但对付二阶妖兽——她拍了拍妖兽的脖颈。

    妖兽会意四蹄发力轻盈地跃过枯树堆。

    但就在妖兽落地的瞬间，地面骤然塌陷。

    那是一个用树枝和杂草伪装起来的深坑。

    妖兽一脚踏空整个身子向下坠去。

    少女反应极快，在妖兽失足的刹那腾身而起，脚尖在妖兽背上轻轻一点，如飞燕般掠出陷阱范围稳稳落在三丈外。

    而她胯下的妖兽可就没这么好运了。

    这头二阶妖兽虽然皮糙肉厚，但数丈深的陷阱里布满了削尖的铁桦木桩——苏余在削这些木桩时选了最硬的铁桦木，又在尖端涂了一层腐骨藤汁液。

    腐骨藤本身毒性不强但能腐蚀角质，妖兽的鳞甲本质上就是角质。

    木桩刺入鳞甲缝隙后腐骨藤汁液顺着伤口渗入，让原本只是皮外伤的伤口迅速溃烂扩大，虽不致命却也让它吃痛发狂。

    妖兽发出愤怒的嘶鸣，四蹄在陷阱中疯狂蹬踏。

    但陷阱太深，那条被毒过的后腿又使不上全力，一时间竟爬不上来。

    少女的脸色终于变了。

    不是因为妖兽受伤——而是因为她感知不到那个矿奴的气息了。

    就在她跃出陷阱的那一瞬间，对方的气息从她的感知中彻底消失，仿佛这个人根本不存在。

    她闭上眼神识铺开。

    炼气九层的神识足以覆盖方圆五十丈。

    风吹草动、虫鸣鸟叫——一切都清清楚楚。

    唯独没有那个人。

    “怎会如此？”

    少女蹙眉。

    她的神识扫过每一寸地面和树冠，却始终找不到任何踪迹。

    她瞥见不远处有一片泛着腐臭的黑色沼泽，泥面上还残留着几道刚留下的痕迹——那小子定是滚进了沼泽里，用淤泥裹住全身。

    沼泽的腐臭连妖兽的鼻子都能骗过，何况神识？

    少女拔出背上长剑。

    剑长三尺三寸，剑身窄如柳叶泛着幽蓝寒光。

    剑名“听霜”，下品灵器，比寻常下品法器锋利数倍。

    “我知道你就在附近。”

    少女缓缓转动手腕，剑尖扫过四周密林，“你能藏，但你能藏多久？”

    回应她的是林间的风声。
content_en:
The monster walked slowly in the dense forest.

    Most of the numbness in the hind legs has subsided, but the leg is still a little weak and the speed is 20% slower than usual.

    This made the demonic beast very irritable, and it kept blowing out heavy breath from its nostrils, and its eyes scanned the dense forest to find traces of the human who dared to make it crumble.

    The girl sat on the monster's back with a calm expression.

    She is not in a hurry - how long can a mortal with no cultivation ability, with some unknown opportunities and the ability to use poison, escape from her hands?

    One stick of incense, at most one stick of incense.

    The monster suddenly stopped and snorted.

    Ten feet ahead, several dead trees lay scattered on the road, their trunks covered with thick moss.

    Tripping the rope?

    There was a trace of sarcasm on the girl's lips.

    Using a dead tree as a bridle might be useful against ordinary horses, but against a second-level monster—she patted the monster's neck.

    The demonic beast understood and used its hooves to leap lightly over the pile of dead trees.

    But the moment the monster landed, the ground suddenly collapsed.

    It was a deep pit camouflaged with branches and weeds.

    The demonic beast stepped on the air and its entire body fell downwards.

    The girl reacted very quickly, and when the monster lost its footing, she jumped up, lightly tapped her toes on the monster's back, and flew out of the trap like a flying swallow, landing steadily three feet away.

    The monster under her crotch was not so lucky.

    Although this second-level monster had rough skin and thick flesh, the trap several feet deep was filled with sharpened iron birch stakes. When Su Yu cut these stakes, he chose the hardest iron birch wood and applied a layer of rotten bone vine juice on the tips.

    The rotten bone vine itself is not very toxic but can corrode horny skin. The scales of monster beasts are essentially horny.

    After the wooden stake penetrated the gap between the scales, the juice of the rotten bone vine seeped into the wound, causing the wound that was originally just a skin injury to rapidly fester and expand. Although it was not fatal, it made it go crazy with pain.

    The monster roared angrily and stamped its hooves wildly in the trap.

    But the trap was too deep, and the poisoned hind legs couldn't use their full strength, so they couldn't climb out for a while.

    The girl's expression finally changed.

    It wasn't because the monster was injured - it was because she could no longer sense the aura of the mine slave.

    The moment she jumped out of the trap, the other person's breath completely disappeared from her perception, as if this person did not exist at all.

    She closed her eyes and spread her consciousness.

    The consciousness of the ninth level of Qi Refining is enough to cover a radius of fifty feet.

    The movement of wind and grass, the chirping of insects and the chirping of birds - everything is clear.

    Only there is no such person.

    "How could this be?"

    The girl frowned.

    Her consciousness scanned every inch of the ground and tree canopy, but she could never find any trace.

    She caught a glimpse of a putrid black swamp not far away, and there were still a few fresh traces left on the mud - the kid must have rolled into the swamp and wrapped himself in mud.

    The putrid odor of the swamp can even fool the noses of monsters, let alone spiritual consciousness?

    The girl drew the sword from her back.

    The sword is three feet and three inches long, and the blade is as narrow as a willow leaf glowing with a cold blue light.

    The name of the sword is "Tingshuang", a low-grade spiritual weapon, several times sharper than ordinary low-grade magical weapons.

    "I know you're nearby."

    The girl slowly turned her wrist, and the tip of the sword swept through the surrounding dense forest, "You can hide, but how long can you hide?"

    What responded to her was the sound of wind in the forest.
title_en: Chapter 5: Setting a trap in the dense forest to hunt down the female nun Qingyun
